name: emergency-repeats-attach-to-one-escalation
pins: Escalation dedup, and the trap underneath it. After the first message the run is terminal, so it is no longer the *active* run — the naive path therefore creates a fresh run and a fresh escalation for every repeat, turning one frightened patient into five queue items for a human to reconcile. Repeats must attach: one run, one escalation, an occurrence count that climbs. Turns 4 and 5 pin the other half — `escalated` is the one state a withdrawal must not close. Turn 4 reports no status on purpose: the escalated run is terminal, so the patient has no *active* run for that turn to belong to, and the reply is the scope template. Turn 5 then shows the run itself is untouched, still escalated and still collecting triggers.

turns.message: chest pain again, it is getting worse
